cases.name: original compact unchanged
cases.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { toRaw, useAttrs } from 'vue';
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const props = defineProps<{ label?: string; constructor?: string; hasOwnProperty?: string }>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const currentProps = () => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(toRaw(props)).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined));
</script>
<template><output>{{ JSON.stringify({ props: currentProps(), attrs: { ...attrs } }) }}</output></template>

browserCases.name: five literal compact props
browserCases.title: Compact / Literal
browserCases.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { toRaw, useAttrs } from 'vue';
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const props = defineProps<{ label?: string; "scope.name"?: string; __proto__?: string; constructor?: string; hasOwnProperty?: string }>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const currentProps = () => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(toRaw(props)).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined));
</script>
<template><output>{{ JSON.stringify({ props: currentProps(), attrs: { ...attrs }, ownProto: Object.hasOwn(toRaw(props), "__proto__"), prototypeUnchanged: Object.getPrototypeOf(Object.prototype) === null && Object.prototype.constructor === Object }) }}</output></template>
